name: FDE — Guidance Book of Forward-Deployed Engineer
tagline: A forward-deployed engineer field guide from 范冰, author of 增长黑客 (Growth Hacking)
description: FDE — Guidance Book of Forward-Deployed Engineer is a field guide for the Forward-Deployed Engineer role, written by 范冰, the author of 增长黑客 (Growth Hacking). It combines the practical, on-the-ground playbooks of FDE work — scoping, rapid delivery, and client partnership — with the growth-hacking mindset its author is known for. The book-style repo has become a reference for engineers and teams exploring the increasingly popular FDE model. At 3.8k stars it is one of the more substantial takes on the discipline.
highlights: A dedicated field guide to the Forward-Deployed Engineer role
Written by 范冰, author of 增长黑客 (Growth Hacking)
Practical playbooks for scoping, rapid delivery, and client partnership
3.8k stars as a widely-referenced take on the FDE model
curatorNote: The FDE role is everywhere in AI start-ups right now, but few people have written it up as a real discipline. Coming from the author of Growth Hacking, this guide carries real credibility.
